checks.detail: session A binds the current membership
session B suspension waits on the lock A holds
session A grant is recorded under the binding it was admitted with
session B suspension commits after A commits
the next request after the suspension is refused
session A binding waits on the uncommitted suspension
session A re-reads the committed suspension and is refused
session A sets the legacy claim context
session B suspension commits at once, without waiting for session A

limitations: A local disposable PostgreSQL cluster with fictional rows; not Aurora, the RDS Data API, a deployed Lambda or a hosted run.
The candidate SQL is loaded into this throwaway cluster only; nothing is registered, applied or deployed.
